rationale: B wins because it has sharper fail-safes, not because A is weak. B's line, "Do not pitch this angle without the methodology in hand," is exactly the scar tissue this assignment needed; A gets close with "The study saying it works hasn't been peer-reviewed," but it occasionally dresses outside assumptions as context instead of forcing proof first. Both are real strategist material, but B is less likely to get a founder embarrassed in a reporter's first reply.
gaps_in_A: "While VC-backed EdTech companies charge districts" is not in the update. It may be true in the market, but this set was supposed to stay inside the supplied facts unless it labels the claim as something to verify.
"a body of research on productive failure and desirable difficulty argues" adds an external academic frame not supplied in the update. Useful if sourced, sloppy if smuggled in as fact.
"This is no longer a pilot" is a fair inference from the 30-district expansion, but it should be phrased more carefully because the update does not describe implementation stage or duration.
The next step says "three of the four angles have specific enough journalist shapes," when all four have a plausible shape; the real gate is proof, especially study methodology and named sources.
gaps_in_B: "competitors sell" is not in the supplied update. B partly catches itself with "do not assert competitor pricing you have not verified," but the headline still rests on an unproven comparison.
"The prevailing belief is that a nonprofit's free tool sidesteps the scrutiny applied to commercial edtech" is a tidy thesis, not a sourced fact from the update. It needs proof or it needs to go.
"the pilot districts have a full stretch of classroom use behind them" overstates what we know. The update says there were pilot districts and regular users, not how long classrooms used it.

"nothing here is anchored to a breaking story" is too harsh: the rollout plus first classroom results are the announcement peg. The better point is that there is no independent external news signal beyond Khan's own announcement.
